yinyang-empty

<用户自制> 阴阳空白版：从共同核心与形成方法出发，发展自己的哲学、个人材料和协作安排。 Form and revise your own philosophy, personal material, working models, and environment without bundling the author's essays or diagrams.

GitHub source

When to use it

Choose Empty to develop your own YinYang with a model from shared core methods and an unfilled structure.

“Start from these unfilled files and help me develop my own YinYang from my purposes and material.”

What is included

Six formation guides, Core views as suggestions, practice overview, formation and revision, and daily collaboration; four empty Personal areas and six unfilled Situated files. No docs or diagrams.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select yinyang-empty。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
